Confirm the capped size on your GST invoice before admission day. +91-9999882858 / info@knowledgenation.co.in.

faqs.question: What is the ideal CLAT coaching batch size?
faqs.answer: For legal reasoning, 25–35 students per mentor is a common sweet spot. KNLC publishes 30–35; CLAT Prep and Sriram may run smaller. National chains often exceed 40—confirm your centre.

faqs.question: Does a smaller batch guarantee a better CLAT rank?
faqs.answer: No guarantee—but smaller rooms help doubt clearance and mock discussion. Pair batch size with mock quality and faculty continuity.

faqs.question: How do I verify batch size before paying?
faqs.answer: Ask for the capped number on the fee card, visit a live class if allowed, and read recent Google reviews mentioning overcrowding.

faqs.question: Where are KNLC’s small batches located?
faqs.answer: Hauz Khas HQ (Kalu Sarai, Delhi) and Gurgaon Sector 14 classroom. Phone +91-9999882858.

faqs.question: Are online CLAT batches larger than classroom?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. Hybrid slots may share web cohorts with 100+ students—ask how doubt tickets work before you choose online-only.
